name: @react-doctor/cfg
description: Internal: per-function control-flow graph + dominance/reachability analyses over an ESTree AST. Models the React Compiler HIR / oxc_cfg terminal taxonomy so rules can ask whether a node runs unconditionally, is reachable, dominates, or sits inside a loop. Not published.

scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && cross-env NODE_ENV=production vp pack
